mainEntity.name: What is the most recent AI model release?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most recent tracked release is Meta Muse Spark Open, released Oct 15, 2026. Meta's new open-weight model for coding and agent tasks, which Meta calls the most capable US open-weight model so far. The weights are free to download, and Meta worked with Apple so it can run locally on a pair of Mac Studios. Meta's top Muse Wonder models stay closed.

mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from Google?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest Google release in this tracker is Gemini 4 Argon (General Availability), released Oct 13, 2026. Google's newest frontier model is now broadly available, after launching only to vetted cyber defenders. Developers and enterprises can use it through the paid Gemini API, AI Studio and Google Cloud, and Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers get it in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search.

mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from OpenAI?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest OpenAI release in this tracker is GPT-6 & Intelligent UI in ChatGPT (All Users), released Oct 7, 2026. GPT-6 is now the default in ChatGPT chat for everyone, with paid plans on GPT-6 Sol and Free and Go users on GPT-6 Luna. A new Intelligent UI lets answers mix text with charts, maps, buttons, forms and small on-the-spot tools like calculators, and web-search answers start noticeably faster.

mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from Anthropic?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest Anthropic release in this tracker is Claude Haiku 5.5, released Oct 7, 2026. Anthropic's new small, fast model and the last of the 5.5 family, built for high-volume work like summaries, classification and live customer support, and costing far less than Haiku 4.5. It's the first Haiku with an adjustable effort setting, and it can act as a cheap helper agent alongside Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5.

mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from DeepSeek?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest DeepSeek release in this tracker is DeepSeek V4-Pro (0813 Official Release), released Aug 12, 2026. DeepSeek's flagship V4-Pro model graduated from preview to full production after a nearly four-month preview period, with no changes to API pricing or integration for existing users.
